messages:
Sam Chen: Kicking off Marigold Health onboarding. Objective: deliver a private inference sandbox for clinical form parsing + embeddings and a pilot integration with their case management system by the end of Q2. Need owners for infra, SSO, security proof, success metrics, and a simple ROI snapshot for procurement. Add yourselves.

Marina (Marigold): Thanks Sam. Primary contacts: Marina (product), Diego (IT), Pri (security). Main constraint: must demonstrate purge + audit proof for 30-day retention.

Zoe Li: I'll own CSM and enablement. Proposed success criteria: 1) SSO SAML working for 15 pilot users, 2) p95 <= 380ms at 256 tokens, 3) embeddings achieve >= baseline similarity on holdout set, 4) two enablement sessions and ops runbook handed to Marigold.

Theo (SE): I'll handle perf harness and ROI calc. Prefer private VPC deploy with Splunk forwarding. Need sample docs and holdout set from Marigold to run evals.

Raj Patel: Infra note: can provision private instance and forward logs. Question: does Marigold require HSM? If not, we can use KMS and a dedicated key. ETA for sandbox: 4 business days.

Casey (AE): Renewal note: contract review in ~11 months. If we can't show secure deletion plus cost delta by week 6, renewal risk becomes medium. AE needs a 1-page ROI by week 5.

onboard-bot: Attached: https://redwood-internal.docs/marigold/onboarding/playbook-v1  includes SSO runbook, perf harness, ROI template, compliance checklist.

Marina (Marigold): We'll provide holdout data and SSO metadata by EOD Wednesday. Also need a short demo for clinicians during week 3.

Zoe Li: Enablement agenda draft: 1) 20m product + UI walkthrough, 2) 30m integration & secrets, 3) 40m perf & evals (Theo), 4) 15m ops handoff. Proposed dates: week of May 9.

Theo (SE): I'll present perf. Sample command I'll use once endpoint up:
```
python bench.py --endpoint https://sandbox.marigold.redwood/api/v1/complete --concurrency 6 --seq 256 --duration 300
```

Raj Patel: Sandbox provisioning started. Will post endpoint and rotated creds in thread when ready. Also enabling KV cache for pilot.

Marina (Marigold): Confirming retention window: 30 days for test artifacts. Security requires a purge proof email from Redwood after each pilot run.

Zoe Li: Action items recap:
- Raj: sandbox + creds + Splunk forwarding (due in 72h)
- Theo: perf harness + ROI 1-pager (after endpoints)
- Marina: share holdout set + SSO metadata (due Wed)
- Casey: prep commercial timeline & renewal notes (week 5)

Casey (AE): I'll coordinate procurement ask and expect a short ROI snapshot. If perf and deletion verify, I'll escalate for pilot-to-prod clause.

onboard-bot: Reminder: "Security signoff" pending. Assigning to Zoe & Marigold security.

Sam Chen: Scheduling weekly sync: Fridays 9am PT, first recap in 7 days. Adding a brief intro for Marigold participants to the invite. Locking thread; reply in the meeting thread for new work items.
